Heltec-Mac SE Flasher

Puts Heltec-Mac SE on a Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4 over USB. Firmware (1552 KB, md5 b7d1ed3b) is built in.

1Check this browser

Checking...

2Plug in and connect

  • Use a USB-C cable that carries data (many charging cables don't).
  • Close anything else using the board: the Meshtastic web client or app, Arduino Serial Monitor, other flasher tabs.
  • Click Connect and pick the board. The V4 uses the ESP32-S3's own USB: on Windows it shows as USB JTAG/serial debug unit or USB Serial Device (COM port); on a Mac, usbmodem.

3Flash

⇅Back up or clone a board (optional)

A backup is an exact copy of the whole board: the firmware, your ROM, every disk in the library and the Wi-Fi settings. Restore it later, or write it onto a second Heltec V4 to make a clone. Connect first (step 2).

A backup holds your Wi-Fi password and your Apple ROM, so keep the file to yourself.

4First start

The board restarts by itself (if the screen stays dark, tap RST once). Then join the Wi-Fi hotspot Heltec-MacSE-Setup (password heltecmac), open http://192.168.4.1, pick your home network, and upload your ROM and a disk on the page it shows next.

5Watch the board start (optional)

Shows what the board prints while it starts: Wi-Fi, memory and whether the Mac started. Useful if it gets stuck. Click Disconnect above first if you're still connected for flashing.




?If it won't connect or flash


The board isn't in the list, or nothing happens
    

  • Try another cable or USB port (a port on the computer itself, not a hub).
    • 

  • The V4 needs no extra driver: it uses the ESP32-S3's own USB. If it doesn't show up, put it in download mode (hold PRG, tap RST, let go) and click Connect again.
    • 

  • On Linux, add yourself to the dialout group, then log out and back in.
    • 



"Failed to connect" or it stops at "Connecting..."
    

  • Put the board in download mode by hand: hold PRG, tap RST, let go of PRG. Then click Connect again.
    • 

  • Pick Slow (115200) under Speed.
    • 

  • Make sure no other program or browser tab has the port open.
    • 



It flashed, but the screen stays blank or keeps rebooting
    

  • Flash again with Erase the whole board first ticked.
    • 

  • Press RST once after flashing.
    • 



Going back to Meshtastic
  • Use the official flasher at flasher.meshtastic.org.
